settings.title: One team for
settings.intro: Whether you're buying your first home, selling the one you've raised a family in, or building a portfolio, the same agents who know the market handle your deal end to end.

design.title: Buyer representation
design.text: We find homes that match your list, negotiate on your side, and walk you through every inspection and document. You never bid blind.

design.title: First-time buyer guidance
design.text: From pre-approval to closing day, we explain each step in plain language and keep you from the costly mistakes first-timers make.

build.title: Pricing & staging
build.text: We price your home to attract real offers, stage it to show its best, and market it across every major platform to reach the right buyers.

build.title: Negotiation & closing
build.text: We handle offers, counteroffers, inspections, and the paperwork — so you net the best price with the least stress.

launch.title: Investment analysis
launch.text: We run the numbers on rental yield, appreciation, and cash flow so you buy properties that perform, not just ones that look good.

launch.title: Portfolio growth
launch.text: From your first rental to a multi-property portfolio, we help you scale with the right financing and the right properties.

settings.title: A clear path
settings.intro: Buying or selling shouldn't feel like a maze. Here's the straightforward process we guide every client through.

steps.title: Consultation
steps.text: We sit down, learn your goals, and give you an honest read on the market — whether you're ready to move now or just exploring.

steps.title: Search & showings
steps.text: We curate homes that actually fit your list, book showings around your schedule, and give you the real story on each property.

steps.title: Offer & negotiate
steps.text: We craft a competitive offer or a smart counter, then negotiate the terms that matter to you — price, timeline, and contingencies.

steps.title: Close & beyond
steps.text: We manage inspections, financing, and closing so the keys land in your hand on schedule. And we stay a call away long after.

settings.note: Most of our buyers are under contract within six weeks of their first showing. We'll give you a realistic timeline up front and keep you informed at every step.

settings.title: The difference is
settings.intro: Anyone can put a sign in the yard. We win because we show up — with market data, honest advice, and a team that answers the phone.

features.title: Local, not corporate
features.text: Our agents live in the neighborhoods they sell. They know the schools, the commute times, and the blocks that hold their value.

features.title: Data-driven pricing
features.text: Every listing is priced with a full market analysis — not a guess. That's why our homes sell fast and close at the number.

features.title: One team, end to end
features.text: The agent who shows you the home is the one who negotiates and closes it. No hand-offs, no dropped balls.

features.title: Transparent fees
features.text: You see every fee in writing before you sign. What we quote is what you pay — no surprise line items at closing.

features.title: Full-service support
features.text: Lenders, inspectors, title companies, and movers — we've vetted the partners we recommend, so you don't have to.

features.title: We stay in touch
features.text: Long after closing, we check in on your home's value and your next move. Most of our business is referrals from past clients.

settings.title: Questions buyers
settings.intro: Straight answers about fees, timing, and what it's really like to work with us.

items.question: How much does it cost to work with you as a buyer?
items.answer: In most cases, nothing out of pocket. Buyer's agent commissions are typically paid by the seller at closing. We'll confirm the exact terms in writing before we start.

items.question: How do you price a home to sell?
items.answer: We run a full comparative market analysis — recent sales, active listings, and market conditions in your specific neighborhood. We price to attract real offers, not to sit on the market.

items.question: How long does it take to sell my home?
items.answer: Our average is 14 days on market, but it depends on your home, your price, and the season. We'll give you a realistic timeline up front and adjust as the market moves.

items.question: Do you work with first-time buyers?
items.answer: Absolutely — it's a big part of what we do. We'll walk you through pre-approval, showings, offers, and closing in plain language, and help you avoid the common first-time mistakes.

items.question: Can you help me invest in rental properties?
items.answer: Yes. We run the numbers on yield, cash flow, and appreciation, and we'll be honest when a deal doesn't make sense. We've helped clients build portfolios from a single rental to a dozen.
